comment: Patch profiles: every profile whose 'match' rules all hold is applied. Paths are relative to assets/patches/. Positions: beforeEngine (before any game script), beforePlugins (after rpg_*.js, before the plugins), afterPlugins (after the last plugin, before the game starts). Order inside mv-base matters: perf.js and renderer.js before debug.js, which reads the first and wraps the second; lifecycle.js after framerate.js, whose requestUpdate it wraps; nwjs.js before stubs that register modules with it. Match rules: title (regular expression, case-insensitive), plugins (enabled plugin names), pluginSha256 (plugin name to SHA-256 of js/plugins/<name>.js), engine ({min, max} MV versions), usesGreenworks (true or false).

profiles.comment: Steam builds load greenworks through require(); give them a no-op module.
